parameters.query: SELECT ni.id, ni.issue_number, ni.intro_html, ni.outro_html, ni.subject_line, ni.sponsor_html FROM newsletter_issues ni WHERE ni.status = 'building' AND ni.full_html IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT ns.title as section_title, a.id as article_id, a.url, a.title, a.author, a.summary, a.key_points, a.image_url, nsa.blurb, c.name as category, c.icon FROM newsletter_section_articles nsa JOIN newsletter_sections ns ON ns.id = nsa.section_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = nsa.article_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE ns.issue_id = '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid ORDER BY ns.sort_order, nsa.sort_order
UPDATE newsletter_issues SET full_html = '{{ $json.full_html }}', status = 'review', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.issue_id }}'::uuid
